name: Yebona
audience: Businesses planning sourcing and imports between China and Africa.

features.title: China sourcing services | Yebona
features.description: Prepare a China sourcing request and ask about available providers through Yebona.
features.headline: Tell the sourcing agent exactly what you need.
features.intro:
Start with the goods you want, the quantity and the checks you need. A clear request makes the sourcing conversation easier.

Yebona presents trade-service providers and invites early-access enquiries. Ask which sourcing services are currently available, then agree what the provider will do before committing.

Yebona presents trade-service providers and invites early-access enquiries. Ask which sourcing services are currently available, then agree what the provider will do before committing.
features.audience: Businesses planning sourcing and imports between China and Africa.

benefits.title: Write the requirement
benefits.body: Name the product and important details. Include the quantity and requirements that will affect the search.

benefits.title: Look at the service
benefits.body: Check what the provider offers rather than assuming every sourcing agent does the same work.

benefits.title: Agree the job
benefits.body: Ask what is included, what evidence you will receive and what you need to handle yourself.

steps: Name the goods, quantity and details that matter.
Agree what the provider will do and the terms.
features.limitations: Yebona is accepting early-access enquiries. Confirm provider and service availability before placing an order.
features.example: An importer can explain the goods they need and ask an agent what supplier checks and sourcing work are included.
features.availability: Early-access enquiries. Confirm which providers and services are currently available.

video.title: Prepare a sourcing or shipping enquiry
video.transcript:
Need goods from China? Name the product and quantity. Add the details that matter to your order. Ask Yebona for access and explain the help you need.

When a service is available, read what the provider offers. Ask about anything missing. Agree what they will do and what you will receive before choosing them.

For shipping, give the route and check what the quote covers. Confirm availability and terms before you commit. Ask Yebona about your sourcing needs to start.

features.title: Compare import-services | Yebona
features.description: Look through Yebona provider services and supporting information before choosing who to work with.
features.headline: Compare what the provider will actually do.
features.intro:
Two providers with the same category can offer very different work. Check the service details, available portfolio and feedback, then ask about anything important that is missing.

The aim is a clear agreement about the job, rather than choosing from a name or headline alone.
paragraphs: Two providers with the same category can offer very different work. Check the service details, available portfolio and feedback, then ask about anything important that is missing.

features.audience: Businesses planning sourcing and imports between China and Africa.

benefits.title: Read the service details
benefits.body: Make sure the offer fits the import task you need help with.

benefits.title: Look for supporting work
benefits.body: Check portfolio and feedback information where it is available. Ask questions when a claim needs more detail.

benefits.title: Compare the whole offer
benefits.body: Clarify the work, timing, charges and exceptions before deciding who to engage.

features.limitations: Early-access and provider availability apply. A profile is a starting point for your checks, not a guarantee.
features.example: For a factory inspection, ask what will be inspected and what report you will receive. Compare those answers before choosing the provider.
features.availability: Early-access enquiries. Confirm which providers and services are currently available.

features.title: Freight and shipping enquiries | Yebona
features.description: Prepare your China–Africa shipping requirements and ask about freight services through Yebona.
features.headline: Explain the shipment before asking for a quote.
features.intro:
Where are the goods, where do they need to go and what needs moving? Start with those details when discussing a shipment.

Yebona’s service guide includes freight and shipping. Ask which services are currently available and what each provider will handle, including the parts of the journey left to you.
paragraphs: Where are the goods, where do they need to go and what needs moving? Start with those details when discussing a shipment.

features.audience: Businesses planning sourcing and imports between China and Africa.

benefits.title: Describe the goods
benefits.body: Share the shipment details you know. Mark unknown sizes, weights or dates for confirmation.

benefits.title: Check what is included
benefits.body: Ask about transport, customs and local delivery separately, so gaps in the offer are clear.

benefits.title: Confirm the terms
benefits.body: Look at the actual quote and responsibilities before committing money or arranging the shipment.

steps: Ask which shipping services are available.
features.limitations: Freight services, charges and customs requirements depend on the actual shipment. Confirm availability and timings.
features.example: An importer can ask whether a quote covers only the international leg or also the collection and local delivery they need.
